observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: on a stage with a dark backdrop featuring small glowing lights resembling stars, and a potted plant on the right
observation.formation_and_space: line formation that changes into a small circle, then back to a line across the stage
observation.posture: upright torso, held stiff and straight with weight predominantly on the balls of the feet and toes
observation.footwork: rapid crossing, hopping, skipping, toe-heel taps, and high knee lifts on every beat with rhythmic tapping sound from hard shoes
observation.arms_and_hands: held rigidly straight down by the sides or holding hands with partners in a line or circle
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright and largely still while legs execute intricate steps
observation.partnering: holding hands in a line and in a small circle, no lead-and-follow partnering
observation.levels_jumps_turns: constant hopping and jumping on toes, high kicks, low turns within the group circle
observation.costume_and_props: matching intricate long-sleeved dresses with colorful jeweled patterns (red, pink, white/red gradient), white socks, and hard Irish dance shoes; tiaras in hair
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and ankle mechanics are partially obscured during rapid sequences and low camera angles

signature_moments.what: dancers hop and lift knees high in place while holding hands in a line
solo dancer performs high leg extensions and rapid heel clicks
dancer in white and red dress performs rapid hopping and toe taps across the stage
all three dancers hold hands and hop on one foot in unison
dancers form a small circle and skip in a rotation
